name: Otago Golf Club
note: OpenStreetMap hole pars 1-18 checked against the club's course page: holes 1-10 and 16 match its single pars, and for holes 11-15, 17 and 18 (which the club lists with several pars by tee) the OSM value is one of them. The club page states no total par. OSM also maps a 19th hole, 'X-ways' (par 3), which the club's list does not include, so it is ignored.

name: Waihi Golf Club
note: Every hole's par is taken from the club's own hole-by-hole tables (men and women are identical), total 72. OpenStreetMap agreed on 17 holes; its hole 5 was an invalid value and the club lists par 5.

name: Northland Golf Club
note: The club states 'a par 71, 18-hole course' but does not list hole pars. OpenStreetMap had a usable par for 17 holes (sum 67) and an invalid value for hole 13. Hole 13 is recorded as par 4 because that is the only value that makes the club's stated total of 71; the club does not state hole 13's par itself.
